scope.title: EvidencePack: Retail Trends (focus: AI, trust, private labels, searchless retail)
scope.description: This EvidencePack will collect and synthesise evidence on major retail trends (invisible AI/GenAI, trust & data practices, private-label growth, experience-led retail, and searchless/GEO) from the uploaded source documents. The uploaded Capgemini report (Retail trends 2026) is included as a primary source: CAPGEMINI - 2026-Retail-Trends_ACIG.pdf .
objectives: Identify and summarize the key retail trends described in the provided documents.
Extract quantitative metrics and claims (e.g., percentages on AI adoption, trust measures, private-label uptake) and record their sources.
Derive implications and practical recommendations for retail stakeholders based on the evidence.
Produce a concise evidence summary and an annotated list of source excerpts for verification.
research_questions: What are the primary retail trends described in the provided documents for 2024–2026 (AI adoption, trust, private labels, experience economy, searchless retail)?
What quantitative metrics and claims are presented (with exact phrasing and page references) regarding consumer attitudes and adoption?
What risks, trust concerns, and recommended guardrails are identified for AI in retail?
What operational or strategic recommendations do the sources propose for retailers?
inclusion_criteria: Uploaded documents and attachments provided by the user (PDFs, reports, presentations).
Materials published 2019–2026 that address retail trends, AI/GenAI in retail, consumer trust, private labels, or searchless/GEO retail.
Documents containing primary statistics, explicit claims, or actionable recommendations.
exclusion_criteria: Social media posts, short-form marketing copy, or opinion pieces without supporting evidence.
Materials unrelated to retail trends or outside the 2019–2026 timeframe unless directly relevant background.
Duplicative files with identical content (only the canonical source will be used).
scope.population: Retail industry stakeholders (retailers, brands, digital commerce teams) and consumers referenced in the source materials.

data_sources.name: CAPGEMINI - 2026-Retail-Trends_ACIG.pdf
data_sources.role: Primary industry report (contains quantitative findings and recommendations)

expected_deliverables: Executive summary (1 page) of key findings and recommendations
Annotated evidence table: extracted claims, numeric metrics, exact quotes, and source citation/page
Short slide-style summary of strategic implications (3–5 slides) or equivalent text
constraints_and_assumptions: Analysis limited to uploaded files and excerpts contained therein unless user provides additional sources.
All extracted claims will be attributed to their source; where page numbers are unavailable, the filename and citation marker will be recorded.
No primary data collection (surveys/interviews) will be performed.
